usedFor: Render reports service events and deploys, and LeadConnector records them on a contact, for example with “Add/Remove Tags to Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Deploy Finished” in Render, then “Add/Remove Tags to Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A deploy that ends live, failed or canceled can tag a chosen contact in LeadConnector.

watchOut: “Add/Remove Tags to Contact” finds the contact by email or phone, which a Render service event lacks, so supply one.
